package relationdeleteconsumer

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db/sqlite"
	migrationbackend "github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/backend"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/query"
)

var (
	_ db.Queryer                              = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ db.Mutator                              = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ db.Session                              = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ db.Atomic                               = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ db.RelationAtomic                       = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ migrationbackend.AtomicBackend          = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ migrationbackend.AppliedMigrationReader = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
	_ migrationbackend.RevisionFencedBackend  = (*sqlite.Backend)(nil)
)

var (
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, func(db.Session) error) error                   = (*sqlite.Backend).Atomic
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, func(db.RelationSession) error) error           = (*sqlite.Backend).AtomicRelation
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context) (migrationbackend.Transaction, error)           = (*sqlite.Backend).BeginMigration
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend) error                                                            = (*sqlite.Backend).Close
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, query.DeletePlan) (int64, error)                = (*sqlite.Backend).Delete
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, string, ...any) (sql.Result, error)             = (*sqlite.Backend).ExecContext
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, query.InsertPlan) (int64, error)                = (*sqlite.Backend).Insert
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context) (migrationbackend.RevisionFencedSession, error) = (*sqlite.Backend).OpenRevisionFencedSession
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, query.Plan) (db.Rows, error)                    = (*sqlite.Backend).Query
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend) uint64                                                           = (*sqlite.Backend).QueryCount
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context) ([]migrationbackend.AppliedMigration, error)    = (*sqlite.Backend).ReadAppliedMigrations
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context) (string, error)                                 = (*sqlite.Backend).SQLiteVersion
	_ func(*sqlite.Backend, context.Context, query.UpdatePlan) (int64, error)                = (*sqlite.Backend).Update
)

// A map key declaration checks comparability without inspecting representation.
var _ map[sqlite.Backend]struct{}
